movements.step1Copy: Paste the chart, organize sections, and have every detail ready for rehearsal.
movements.step2Copy: Mark each line's entry once. From there, timing does the work for you.
movements.step3Copy: Open stage mode, connect the pedal, and keep your eyes on the show.

pricing.title: Your next show starts at the first rehearsal.
pricing.subtitle: Start with the essentials and turn it up as your band grows.
pricing.note: Billed in Brazilian reais. 14 days free on any plan — cancel anytime.

comunidade.previewEmpty: No active listings right now — be the first.
comunidade.titleLine2: on the same beat as you.
comunidade.subtitle: Bands looking for musicians. Musicians looking for a band. Find your next lineup and take the conversation to rehearsal.
comunidade.accessNote: Browse listings without signing in. To publish one, sign in to your account.
comunidade.criteria1Copy: People nearby so rehearsal can actually happen.
comunidade.criteria2Copy: The voice or instrument the lineup is missing.
comunidade.criteria3Copy: From beginner to professional, with aligned expectations.
comunidade.criteria4Copy: Playing for fun, rehearsing, gigging or recording.
comunidade.step1Copy: Does a band need a musician? Looking for people to play with? Add city, instrument, level and goal to the listing.
comunidade.step2Copy: Browse public listings. Check the pitch, rehearsal days and instruments to see if it's a fit.
comunidade.step3Copy: Use the listing's contact info to talk. Align expectations, pick a setlist, and agree on when to play.
comunidade.alertCopy: Fill in your city and instruments in your profile. When a band in your city looks for someone who plays your instrument, the alert shows up in TumTumPa.
comunidade.alertCta: Sign in and complete my profile
comunidade.finalCopy: Your listing could be the start of your next lineup.

classificados.previewNote: Illustrative listings — this feature hasn't launched yet.
classificados.subtitle: We're designing a place to find what your sound is missing and give a new stage to what you no longer use — instruments, audio gear and accessories between musicians.
classificados.accessNote: Concept in development — the listings below are illustrative only, nothing is actually published yet.
classificados.criteria1Copy: Instruments, audio gear and accessories. Start with what your sound is missing.
classificados.criteria2Copy: Know where the gear is to work out the next steps.
classificados.criteria3Copy: Wear, how long it's been used, and anything worth noting.
classificados.criteria4Copy: Price and what's included, up front, before the conversation starts.
classificados.detailsSubtitle: Whoever's looking wants to understand exactly what they're taking home.
classificados.detail1Copy: Show the whole item, the connections and any wear marks.
classificados.detail2Copy: State the model, how it works, any repairs, and what comes with the sale.
classificados.detail3Copy: Work out price, availability and delivery with the other person.
classificados.finalCopy: This feature is still in development — in the meantime, check out the band board, already live.

fluxo.introSubtitle: Same band, a different view: pick the song from the library, follow along on the central stage, and get to your most-used features fast.
fluxo.dockSubtitle: The features used most during rehearsal and the show, always at hand.
fluxo.docksetlistCopy: Build and share the show's order
fluxo.docktransposeCopy: Change key without rewriting the chart
fluxo.dockpedalCopy: Switch songs without taking a hand off your instrument
fluxo.docksyncCopy: Lyrics follow the audio, line by line

redettp.previewEmpty: No public posts yet — be the first.
redettp.subtitle: Profile, band, gig calendar and feed in one place. Like, comment and follow musicians on your wavelength.
redettp.accessNote: Public profiles and bands are visible to everyone. To post and interact, sign in to your account.
redettp.feature1Copy: Show your instruments, your city and the bands you play in.
redettp.feature2Copy: Post rehearsals, shows and releases — like and comment on what the network shares.
redettp.feature3Copy: Announce your band's upcoming shows, with date, venue and tickets.
redettp.feature4Copy: Post an opening in your band or offer your work — TumTumPa doesn't handle payments.
redettp.step1Copy: Add your instruments, city and links to your bands.
redettp.step2Copy: Share on the feed, follow other musicians and bands, like and comment.
redettp.step3Copy: Announce shows on the calendar and reply to hiring posts — the network carries your music further.
redettp.finalCopy: Create your profile and start following musicians and bands on your wavelength.
